description: CYK membership for a context-free grammar in Chomsky normal form: the full triangular table (which variables derive each substring) and whether the word is in the language. Rules like "S -> AB | BC" one per line (→ or ::= also work); single-character symbols, or space-separated words if any variable has several letters. Says which rule is not in CNF if one is not. Returns a link that fills the table cell by cell.

grammar.description:
One rule per line, first left side is the start symbol. E.g. "S -> AB | BC
A -> BA | a
B -> CC | b
C -> AB | a"

name: cyk_parse
